authority: Latest user: do the best next experiments toward a serious improvement of the final metric. Existing twelve-fit cycle remains unchanged.
objective: Improve an eligible fixed TL3/student endpoint; no public gain forecast from proxy results.

validation.ancestry: Only fitting train members may fit normalizers, teachers, initializers, priors or learned transformations.
validation.exposure: Previously inspected development valid; not fresh confirmation. No seq_ix chronology or replacement random folds.

diagnostic.same_groups_all_checkpoints: First256 noncorrupt fitting groups in recorded seed1001 order; official fit membership verified for every checkpoint. No split changes.
diagnostic.scope: Training-only derivative diagnosis; not model quality or independent confirmation.

second_arm_rule.condition: At ep3, BOTH seeds have mean GRU aux-sum/main cosine <= -0.05 and median GRU aux/main norm ratio >=0.5 across the eight frozen batches.
second_arm_rule.if_true: aux_late: hold aux_struct/aux_next=.3 through half of optimizer attempts, then linearly taper to zero at the last planned update; clip1 unchanged.
second_arm_rule.if_false: lr_half: peak LR0.0005 vs0.001, clip1 and constant auxiliaries unchanged; integrated decoupled weight decay also changes.
second_arm_rule.on_diagnostic_execution_failure: Preserve attempt; use source-reviewed aux_late as a prior-motivated unconfirmed hypothesis, not evidence of conflict. No blind GPU retry.

teachers.architecture: GRU256x2 native211, all23 main/struct/next output rows preserved
teachers.arm2: Frozen by training-only diagnostic rule before any new teacher fit.
teachers.baseline: Exact PR61 clip1 scratch controls; same normalizer membership, seeded sample order and initialization; default-off source path audited.
teachers.other_args: Reuse original teacher argv; change only run name and declared treatment. Strict FP32/noAMP/noTF32.

students.selection_rule: Among the two new arms, choose the highest two-seed mean fixed-ep3 full-valid WP only if its mean exceeds reused matched-control mean by >=0.001. Tie within1e-6 resolves to clip5. Otherwise do not spend the optional two student fits. This is selection on exposed development data.
students.recipe: Same train-only W18 GRU256x2/FBC initializer, FP32, AdamW1e-4, batch16/chunk2000,2epochs/fixedep1; change only declared teacher target relative to control.
students.target_formula: T_new=0.8*T_old+0.2*0.8125*mean(clip(new_family_prediction,-2,2)); native training then retains alpha0.7 and its existing clipping/weighting. The0.8125 factor preserves the old preweighted target amplitude.
students.parent: Same clean tl3c_fbc1k_s5@ep3 initializer and qualified PR60 base/family cache.
students.target_storage: Stream both selected teachers directly into one FP32 fit-order target array, no full intermediate train prediction banks. Each model uses its own checkpoint normalization.
students.retention: New target payload is explicitly transient; remove only after both student fits, prediction exports, canonical grades and retained metadata/checkpoints. Never remove old PR60 or current12 caches.

comparison.controls: Reuse original PR61 teacher controls and PR60 W18 student controls.
comparison.metric: Unchanged canonical global_wp_clip2_v1 on full official valid mask
comparison.endpoint: Fixed .9 TL3 + .1 candidate; report all seeds and controls
comparison.uncertainty: Two seeds; exposed development. Teacher-based family selection adds exposure, not independent confirmation.
comparison.deployable_primary: Two-seed W18 singleton gain over matched PR60 W18 controls; identical compact serving architecture. TL3 mixture is a research endpoint until actual CPU serving admission.

requirements: Run actual-shape finite FP32 profiles before new fits.
Save checkpoints, train/valid curves, gradients and source/parent identities.
Use existing run_cell/owned-command/scoring/dashboard helpers; no new controller framework.
Do not modify current12 numerical settings or foreign processes.
Freeze receiving identities from actual bytes, never transcribe terminal hashes.
Post GitHub updates as SemyonEpanov with separate scientific and operational outcomes.
Do not promote an unserved TL3 mixture as a ready submission; validate the actual compact student CPU artifact before final release.
